title: Child Left Home Alone Leads Police Straight to Irresponsible Mother
description:
On August 25th, 2024. Police responded to a situation, regarding a mother who left her kid inside the house for hours then tried to lie on her sister about having the kid.  This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
